posts.title: A quieter workspace after dark
posts.details: A dark theme would make late-night sessions easier on the eyes. Something warm and considered, with the same calm feel as the light theme.

posts.title: Bring the conversation into Slack
posts.details: Let us know when a request picks up momentum, or when something we voted for ships. A small update in the right channel would go a long way.

posts.title: Save the views that matter to you
posts.details: I keep coming back to the same set of filters. It would be lovely to save a few views and switch between them in one click.

posts.title: Take your ideas with you
posts.details: A simple CSV export of posts and votes would help us share the bigger picture with the rest of our team.

posts.title: A shortcut for the little things
posts.details: Pressing / to search, and N to share an idea, would make moving around feel a little faster.

posts.title: A weekly note on what’s new
posts.details: One thoughtful email each week with the ideas gaining traction and the things that shipped. No noise, just the good stuff.

posts.title: Internal planning notes
posts.details: This private request must never appear on public boards or the roadmap.

posts.title: Another quieter workspace request
posts.details: Please merge this with the original idea once reviewed.

entries.plaintextDetails:

Thanks to everyone who shared a vote and helped us get the details right.
